name: Descript
desc: AI-powered video and podcast editor. Import media, run AI edits with Underlord, and publish.

actions.name: import_media
actions.description: Imports a media file from a URL into a new or existing Descript project and optionally creates a composition.

actions.name: agent_edit
actions.description: Use Descript's AI agent "Underlord" to edit an existing project or create a new one with a natural language prompt.

actions.name: publish_project
actions.description: Publishes a composition from a project to create a shareable link and a downloadable export file.

actions.name: get_job_status
actions.description: Retrieves the current status of a Descript background job (import, agent edit, or publish). Use the job_id returned by any job-creation action.

actions.name: list_projects
actions.description: Returns projects in your Descript Drive. Supports filtering by name, date, and creator.

actions.name: get_project
actions.description: Retrieves details for a Descript project including its compositions and media files.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: job_completed
triggers.description: Triggers when a Descript background job (import, agent edit, or publish) finishes.
